title: 🔥 "MILLIONS THINK THEY’RE SAVED—BUT JESUS WILL SAY ‘I NEVER KNEW YOU!’" 🚀🔥
paragraphs: 🔥 "MILLIONS THINK THEY’RE SAVED—BUT JESUS WILL SAY ‘I NEVER KNEW YOU!’" 🚀🔥

📖 Matthew 7:21-23 – "Not everyone who says to Me, ‘Lord, Lord,’ will enter the kingdom of heaven, but only the one who does the will of My Father who is in heaven. Many will say to Me on that day, ‘Lord, Lord, did we not prophesy in Your name, and in Your name drive out demons and in Your name perform many miracles?’ Then I will tell them plainly, ‘I never knew you; depart from Me, you workers of lawlessness!’"

🚨 The most terrifying words in the Bible.
🚨 Millions of "Christians" will stand before Jesus, expecting to enter heaven—only to be REJECTED.

🔥 They thought they were saved… but Jesus never knew them.
🔥 Could YOU be one of them?
Today, we will expose the shocking truth about false salvation—and how to make sure you are truly saved!

🔥 1. CALLING JESUS "LORD" IS NOT ENOUGH!
📖 Luke 6:46 – "Why do you call Me ‘Lord, Lord,’ and not do what I tell you?"

🚨 Many people think they are saved just because they:
❌ Go to church every Sunday.
❌ Read the Bible occasionally.
❌ Pray when they need something.
❌ Say "I believe in Jesus."
❌ Do "good works" and help people.

🔥 But NONE of these things mean you are truly saved!
🔥 Even demons believe in Jesus! (James 2:19)
✅ The real question is: DOES JESUS KNOW YOU?

🔥 2. SIGNS THAT YOU ARE A FAKE CHRISTIAN!
🚨 WARNING: If these describe you, you may NOT be truly saved!

❌ You live in sin without conviction.
📖 1 John 3:9 – "No one born of God makes a practice of sinning."

❌ You love the world more than you love God.
📖 James 4:4 – "Whoever wishes to be a friend of the world makes himself an enemy of God."

❌ You only seek God when you need something.
📖 Matthew 15:8 – "These people honor Me with their lips, but their hearts are far from Me."

❌ You are ashamed to share the gospel.
📖 Mark 8:38 – "Whoever is ashamed of Me and My words, of him will the Son of Man be ashamed."

❌ You ignore the Holy Spirit’s conviction.
📖 Ephesians 4:30 – "Do not grieve the Holy Spirit of God."
🔥 If your life does not reflect Christ, then your faith is DEAD!

🔥 3. TRUE SALVATION PRODUCES A TRANSFORMED LIFE!
📖 2 Corinthians 5:17 – "If anyone is in Christ, he is a new creation. The old has passed away; behold, the new has come."

🚨 TRUE SALVATION MEANS:
✅ A changed heart that hates sin.
✅ A deep love for Jesus and His Word.
✅ A desire to obey God, not just "believe" in Him.
✅ A hunger for righteousness and holiness.
✅ A life that bears FRUIT of the Holy Spirit! (Galatians 5:22-23)
🔥 Being a true Christian is not about RELIGION—it’s about RELATIONSHIP!

🔥 4. WHAT DOES IT MEAN WHEN JESUS SAYS ‘I NEVER KNEW YOU’?"
📖 Greek Word for "Knew" – γινώσκω (ginóskó)
✅ Definition: To know someone intimately, personally, and deeply.
🚨 Jesus isn’t talking about intellectual knowledge—He means a deep, personal relationship!

❌ Fake Christians know ABOUT Jesus, but they don’t KNOW Him personally.
✅ True Christians walk with Him daily, surrendering their lives completely!
🔥 If Jesus doesn’t KNOW you, you will NOT enter heaven!

🔥 5. HOW TO MAKE SURE YOU’RE TRULY SAVED!
📖 Acts 3:19 – "Repent, then, and turn to God, so that your sins may be wiped out."

🚨 TRUE SALVATION REQUIRES:
✔️ Repentance – Turning away from sin and surrendering to Jesus.
✔️ Faith in Christ alone – Not in works, religion, or good deeds.
✔️ Obedience – Living according to God’s commands, not the world’s.
✔️ Intimacy with Jesus – Knowing Him personally, not just religiously.
🔥 It’s not about what you SAY—it’s about how you LIVE!

🙏 POWERFUL PRAYER OF TRUE SALVATION
"Lord Jesus, I don’t want to just call You ‘Lord’—I want to truly KNOW You! Forgive me for my sins. I repent and surrender my life completely to You! Fill me with Your Holy Spirit, transform me, and make me a new creation. From this day forward, I will follow You with all my heart. I am Yours forever! In Jesus’ name, AMEN!" 🙏🔥
